study type: Secondary data analysis of a population database (Maternity Experiences Survey)
exposure: violence experienced in the past two years
Violence experienced in the past two years
cohort: 6,421 Canadian women who participated in the Maternity Experiences Survey in 2006
finding: Significant predictors of a negative labour and birth experience included older age, violence experienced in the past two years, poor self-perceived health, attendance at prenatal classes, unintended pregnancy, caesarean birth, and neonate admission to intensive care.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with an increased risk of negative birth experience (AOR 1.65, 95% CI 1.32-2.06).
